cases.title: Project Cipher Alpha: Cryptic Enterprise 01
cases.description: Deconstruct ASCII & Hexadecimal encoded logs to identify an industrial robotics entity.
cases.hint_text:
Cipher Hint for Case 01:
1. Convert Hex sequence '41 75 72 61' in invoice_register_q2.xlsx to ASCII text to find the Brand Name.
2. Convert Hex byte string '42 65 6e 67 61 6c 75 72 75' in tax_filing_extract.txt to discover Headquarters.
3. Decode ASCII decimal array [73, 83, 82, 79] in executive_leadership_dossier.pdf to uncover the founder origin.

cases.title: Project Cipher Beta: Cryptic Enterprise 02
cases.description: Analyze encoded automotive telemetry and cell procurement ciphers to deduce a clean-energy EV pioneer.
cases.hint_text:
Cipher Hint for Case 02:
1. Decode ASCII decimal sequence '65 116 104 101 114 32 69 110 101 114 103 121' in cell_procurement_ledger.xlsx to find the Company Name.
2. Hex string '42 65 6e 67 61 6c 75 72 75' in fame2_subsidy_audit.pdf reveals Headquarters.
3. ASCII array '73 73 84 32 77 97 100 114 97 115' in founder_biography_dossier.pdf discloses founder background.

cases.title: Project Cipher Gamma: Cryptic Enterprise 03
cases.description: Decipher packaging batch matrices and beverage pulp ciphers of an Indian FMCG brand.
cases.hint_text:
Cipher Hint for Case 03:
1. Convert Hex byte string '50 61 70 65 72 20 42 6f 61 74' in brand_philosophy_dossier.pdf to uncover the Brand Name.
2. Convert Hex string '47 75 72 75 67 72 61 6d' in fssai_compliance_audit.pdf to find Headquarters.
3. Decode ASCII decimal array [67, 111, 99, 97, 45, 67, 111, 108, 97] in founding_team_dossier.pdf to identify the executive heritage.

cases.title: Project Cipher Delta: Cryptic Enterprise 04
cases.description: Decode optical frame lens edger matrices to reveal an omnichannel eyewear retail giant.
cases.correct_additional_fact: Founded by former Microsoft engineer Peyush Bansal
cases.hint_text:
Cipher Hint for Case 04:
1. Convert Hex sequence '4c 65 6e 73 6b 61 72 74' in bhiwadi_mega_factory_audit.pdf to reveal the Brand Name.
2. Convert Hex string '47 75 72 75 67 72 61 6d' in store_expansion_capex.csv for Headquarters.
3. Convert ASCII code array [77, 105, 99, 114, 111, 115, 111, 102, 116] in founder_leadership_dossier.pdf to uncover the founder engineering background.

cases.title: Project Cipher Epsilon: Cryptic Enterprise 05
cases.description: Parse automated warehouse robotics ciphers to uncover a high-growth logistics hardware enterprise.
cases.correct_additional_fact: Founded by former Asian Paints supply chain executives
cases.hint_text:
Cipher Hint for Case 05:
1. Convert Hex sequence '41 64 64 76 65 72 62' in factory_capex_noida.pdf to find the Company Name.
2. Hex string '4e 6f 69 64 61' in gst_filing_noida.txt reveals Headquarters.
3. Decode ASCII decimal string '65 120 45 61 115 105 97 110 32 80 97 105 110 116 115' in founders_profile.pdf to uncover executive heritage.
